admin.title: Panel administrator
admin.intro: 3D models are uploaded and managed from the admin panel (admin.php). Create the first administrator account here: you can then add other people from the panel, as editors or administrators.
admin.optional: Optional: if you leave this step empty, you create the administrator later by opening admin.php, with the configuration key you receive at the end.
admin.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, - and _ (3-32 characters). Used to sign in to the panel.
admin.displayNameHint: How you appear in the change history, e.g. “Jane Smith”.
admin.exists: The panel already has its accounts: users and passwords are managed from admin.php, not from here.
admin.unavailable: The custom/ folder is not writable, so the account cannot be created now. Once it is writable, open admin.php and create it with the configuration key.
admin.errMismatch: the two passwords do not match
admin.errExists: an account was created in the meantime
admin.errWritable: the custom/ folder is not writable

welcome.title: Welcome to 3DCaveViewer
welcome.what: This application publishes 3D cave surveys: an interactive map listing the caves, and a viewer you explore straight from the browser — VR headsets included.
welcome.feature1: Cave map with search and descriptive cards
welcome.feature2: 3D viewer with orbit and first-person navigation
welcome.feature3: Measurements, section planes and point-of-interest notes
welcome.feature4: Sharing, embed code and offline support
welcome.intro: The next steps customise the site with your group's details. Everything you choose is written to custom/settings.ini and can be changed later.
welcome.languageHint: The language selected above becomes the default for visitors. They can still switch it from the language selector.
welcome.notWritable: The custom/ folder is not writable: you can still complete the wizard, but at the end you will have to upload the generated file over FTP.

check.gd: GD extension (social previews and PWA icons)
check.https: Secure connection (required for PWA and VR)

identity.title: Your group
identity.organizationNameHint: Shown in the footer, in page titles and in social previews.
identity.organizationUrlHint: The logo in the top left corner will link here.
identity.appShortNameHint: Shown under the icon when the app is installed on a phone.
identity.appDescriptionHint: Used in meta tags and when sharing.
identity.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. It is saved as custom/logo.png and the PWA icons are generated from it.
identity.gplNotice: GPL v3 licence: the credit to the original author and the “Powered by 3DCaveViewer” footer badge must stay visible. The field below can be edited, but it must keep crediting Davide Brugnoni.
identity.textsWarning: Careful: text entered here overrides the translations and is shown in every language. Leave the fields empty and each language uses its own translation.

theme.title: Site colours
theme.intro: Colours are applied to this page straight away, so you see the result as you pick.

map.title: Map and viewer
map.intro: Search for the area your group works in, or pan the map by hand: the homepage centre is taken from here.
map.search: Search for a place or address
map.searchHint: Places come from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim). The result you pick becomes the map centre.
map.searchEmpty: No results: try the name of the town.
map.searchFailed: Search is not available right now: pan the map by hand.
map.zoomHint: The three zoom levels can be tried out on the map above: pick a field and the map shows that level; zoom the map and the value follows.
map.flyToZoomHint: How close the map gets when a cave is clicked in the list.
map.boundsNote: The bounds beyond which the map cannot be panned are not set here: the map stays free. If you need them, write them in the [map] section of custom/settings.ini.
map.minZoomHint: It cannot be tighter than the initial zoom.

summary.title: Summary
summary.intro: Check the values and save. custom/settings.ini is rewritten keeping its comments, and a backup stays in custom/settings.ini.bak.
summary.manual: The custom/ folder is not writable: on save you will get the file to upload manually.

done.adminCreated: Administrator account “{username}” created: you are already signed in to the admin panel, where you upload models and add other users.
done.adminFailed: The administrator was not created ({reason}). The site settings are saved: create the account from admin.php, with the key above.
done.title: Setup complete
done.intro: The settings have been saved to custom/settings.ini. The site now starts from the cave map.
done.skipped: Some values were not valid and were ignored: those entries keep their default values.
done.keyHint: Keep it: it lets you return to setup.php and change the settings. Download the file below — it is the same one stored in custom/.installed — or delete custom/.installed from the server to reopen the setup without a key.
done.noMarker: custom/.installed could not be written. Download the key file below and upload it via FTP as custom/.installed, otherwise the site will keep showing the setup wizard.

manual.title: Manual save
manual.intro: The custom/ folder is not writable by the server, so the settings were not saved. Copy the text below and upload it over FTP.
manual.step1: Save the content below as custom/settings.ini (replacing the existing file).
manual.step2: If you picked a logo, upload it as custom/logo.png.
manual.step3: Upload the key file as custom/.installed too: from then on the site starts from the map, and that key reopens the setup wizard.
manual.keyHint: Download this file and upload it to the server as custom/.installed, without changing its content. Keep a copy: the key is what reopens the setup wizard.

locked.title: Setup already completed
locked.intro: This site is already configured: the setup wizard stays closed so that nobody can change its settings.
locked.how: To reopen it, enter the configuration key you saved at the end of the setup:
locked.keyHint: It is the line of letters and numbers shown at the end of the setup, also contained in the key file you downloaded.
locked.fileLabel: Or load the key file again
locked.fileHint: The file is read here in the browser and fills the field above: it is not uploaded to the server.
locked.fileRead: Key read from the file: press the button below.
locked.fileEmpty: No key found in this file: check that you picked the right one.
locked.wrongKey: Invalid key. Check that you copied the whole line, with no extra spaces.
locked.noKey: The custom/.installed file holds no key, so there is nothing to type: to reopen the setup wizard, delete that file from the server.
locked.byFile: If you lost the key, delete the custom/.installed file from the server (FTP or hosting panel): the setup wizard opens again.

login.title: Sign in
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator to reset it.

bootstrap.title: First access
bootstrap.intro: No account exists yet. Create the first administrator: to prove you manage this installation you need the configuration key, the one shown (and downloaded) at the end of the setup wizard and stored in custom/.installed.
bootstrap.keyHint: You can also pick the saved file: it is read in the browser, not uploaded.

edit.title: Edit model
edit.invalidJson: This model's metadata file is not valid JSON: saving will rewrite it with the values of this form.
edit.nameHint: Shown on the map, in the list and in the viewer's selector.
edit.folderHint: Identifies the model in addresses (viewer.php?m=…): it cannot be changed later. Suggested automatically from the name.
edit.descriptionHint: Text of the map popup, of the model information and of social previews.
edit.mapLabel: Map: click to place the model
edit.mapHint: Click the map or drag the marker. Without coordinates the model is not shown on the map, but stays in the viewer's selector.
edit.orientationHint: In degrees. Needed by models exported with the Z axis up (e.g. CloudCompare): usually X = -90.
edit.orientNone: Upload a 3D file ("3D file" tab) to see the preview here.
edit.orientUnsupported: The preview is only available for GLB/glTF files.
edit.orientBig: The model is {size}: load it only if needed.
edit.orientLocal: Preview of the selected file ({name}), not saved yet.
edit.orientNoWebgl: Your browser does not support WebGL: set the degrees by hand.
edit.orientCanvas: 3D preview of the model with the floor grid
edit.orientHint: Turn the model until the cave floor is parallel to the grid and up points up, then save: the degrees are written into the fields above and used by the viewer. Drag to turn the view (not the model), scroll to zoom. The buttons rotate around the world axes: red X, green Y (vertical), blue Z.
edit.pendingUpload: Already uploaded: {name} ({size}). Save to use it, or choose another file.
edit.uploadHint: GLB recommended, ideally optimized with the GLB Optimizer (Draco, JPEG/WebP textures). Large files are uploaded in chunks.
edit.replaceHint: The current file is not deleted: it goes to the trash, where an administrator can restore it.
edit.socialDelete: Delete (the viewer generates a new one on the next visit)
edit.socialHint: Optional, ideally 1200×630. If missing, the viewer generates it automatically.
edit.deleteHint: The model disappears from the site and goes to the trash with all its files: it can be restored.
